name: Ultra Cyclist Race
description: The Ultra Cyclist's race overlays for Sauce: a full HUD in its own look (power, ride stats, race board, map, route profile, groups, chat) to use with Zwift's HUD off, plus live commentary and a tactics coach. Right-click any overlay for its settings.
author: Malcolm Barske

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Race
windows.description: Live race data and race recording

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Tactics
windows.description: Overlay with spoken tactical calls from your coach

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Race Board
windows.description: The riders around you - position, gap, watts per kilo, power, heart rate - in The Ultra Cyclist's look, with an adjustable see-through background

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Map
windows.description: The course map - your route, the line you've ridden and the riders around you - in The Ultra Cyclist's look, with an adjustable see-through background

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Power
windows.description: Power, watts per kilo, cadence, heart rate and zone (Zwift's top-left panel)

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Ride Stats
windows.description: Speed, distance, climbing and time, and who you're watching (Zwift's top centre)

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Route Profile
windows.description: The route's elevation with sprints, climbs and riders, the current segment and the distance to finish (Zwift's bottom strip)

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Groups
windows.description: The groups on the road - where each is, how big, the gaps, who's in them - as a road view or Zwift-style bubbles

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Chat
windows.description: Chat and Ride Ons (Zwift's message bubbles)

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Climb
windows.description: The climb pop-up: gradient now, what's left to the top and the climb's profile, shown on climbs

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Draft
windows.description: How much shelter you're getting: watts saved, a gauge and the last minute

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Segment Results
windows.description: Sprint and KOM results as they pop up in Zwift: the leaderboard on the segment, then your place and time

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Power-up
windows.description: The power-up you're holding and what it does, and a countdown while it runs

windows.name: Ultra Cyclist Ladder Score
windows.description: Club Ladder team score live - points, who's ahead, every rider's place - and the final score at the finish
